name: MTN
scale_value: service revenue of over R115.3 billion (H1 2026)

name: Vodacom
evidence: Vodacom Group Limited's FY26 fact sheet (as at 31 March 2026) reports group revenue of R167 652 million for the year ended 31 March 2026, against R152 227 million in FY2025.
note_append: Vodacom's R167.652 billion is group statutory revenue for the year ended 31 March 2026, taken from its own FY26 fact sheet. The group includes Safaricom and Egypt, so it is not a South African-only revenue figure.
